title: idempotency/wrap.go
description: Wrap keeps 'The key row is inserted first and completed in the same transaction', 'A duplicate in progress gets 409, a changed body 422, and a match a replay' and 'A transient failure stores nothing': it takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock with no wait on a hash of the tenant, the principal and the key mixed with the OID of the key table, inserts the key row with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING in the caller's transaction, runs the handler, and completes the row in the same transaction; otherwise it reads the row FOR UPDATE NOWAIT and answers 409, 422 or a replay. A lock failure, SQLSTATE 55P03 or a cancel in a statement of Wrap is 409, and any other database error is a StatementError that hides its SQLSTATE (ST-SUP-RP10-LC25). Tx (with Rollback, so only a transaction fits) and Row are the consumer-side interfaces, SQLTx adapts a *sql.Tx, and Wrap expects READ COMMITTED.
